description.value: Prado Coffee is a well-regarded Vancouver specialty coffee roaster and café group founded by four-time Canadian Barista Champion Sammy Piccolo, with origins on Commercial Drive and now spanning eight-plus neighbourhood locations across Vancouver, Burnaby, and Surrey. The Fir Street location sits in the Fairview/South Granville area, serving carefully sourced espresso drinks and fresh baked goods under the brand's community-first ethos. Cyclists will find it a welcoming mid-ride coffee stop in a walkable, mixed-use corridor of the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Prado Coffee (formerly Prado Cafe / Café Prado) Fir Street location, listed by name in the locations navigation alongside seven other branches. No amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site for any individual location. The corporate contact page lists a different phone number (604-336-9277) and address (4208 Fraser Street) than the OSM record, indicating OSM holds individual-location data while the website's contact page reflects the corporate/head-office entry.
concerns: OSM name 'Café Prado' does not match current branding; website and all materials now use 'Prado Coffee'.
Phone mismatch: OSM lists +1-604-733-8818 but the website contact page shows 604-336-9277, which appears to be the corporate/Fraser Street HQ number.

Website corporate contact address (4208 Fraser Street, Vancouver BC V5V 4G2) differs from OSM address (1809 Fir Street); the Fir Street location is listed by name on the website but no street address is confirmed for it specifically.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established specialty coffee chain with a confirmed Fir Street location; a genuine neighbourhood café that touring cyclists would find useful as a coffee and food stop.
enrichment_extras.notes: Fir Street is explicitly listed as one of Prado Coffee's active locations on the website. The brand has evolved from 'Prado Cafe' / 'Café Prado' to 'Prado Coffee'. No amenity details specific to the Fir Street location are available on the website; a site visit would be needed to verify bike parking, washrooms, and Wi-Fi.

wow_evidence: founded by four-time Canadian Barista Champion Sammy Piccolo... eight-plus neighbourhood locations across Vancouver, Burnaby, and Surrey
